metadata.qa_suite_name: TREVO ONE — TOP BRAZILIAN FOODS QA SET
metadata.description: Permanent professional QA verification set of 200+ fundamental Brazilian nutrition concepts.
governance_rules: Every concept MUST resolve to a recognized PT-BR food or verified branded product.
Cooking or preparation state must remain explicit (e.g. cozido, grelhado, assado, cru).
No raw English titles or laboratory USDA descriptions may appear in default BR top results.
No AI-hallucinated or synthetic macro foods permitted.
All nutrient values must be directly traceable to official tables (IBGE, TACO) or verified manufacturer labels.
